description: Open each URL in a Chromium browser and save a PNG or JPEG screenshot, full page or window only. Returns one row per URL with the image link, final URL, HTTP status, page title, and image size. Pages that refuse the browser come back as free blocked rows.

block_trackers.description: yes (default) skips analytics, ad, and session replay scripts and video or audio files, which draw nothing you need in the image and make pages slower. no loads everything, so ads appear.

delay_ms.description: Extra wait after the page loads and before the capture, 0 to 20000. Default 0.

format.description: png (default) or jpeg. JPEG files are smaller.

full_page.description: yes captures the whole scrollable page, up to 16,000 pixels tall. no (default) captures the visible window only.

hide_selectors.description: Elements to hide before the capture, for example a cookie banner or a chat widget: #cookie-banner, .chat-widget.

jpeg_quality.description: 1 to 100, used for jpeg only. Default 80.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before a charge that would pass this amount. Summary rows are always returned.

proxy_mode.description: auto (default): pages load through the Apify proxy pool. none: pages load straight from the Apify server. A reliability setting only; it does not change what you pay.

scroll_to_bottom.description: yes scrolls down the page before the capture so images that load on scroll appear, then returns to the top. Default no.

timeout_seconds.description: Longest wait for one page to load, 10 to 120. Default 60. A page still loading at this point is captured as it stands and marked partial.

urls.description: Pages to capture, each starting with http:// or https://. A bare domain such as example.com gets https:// added. From Clay, put the column inside a one item list.

viewport_height.description: Browser window height, 240 to 2160. Default 800. With Full page on, the image is as tall as the page.

wait_until.description: When the page counts as loaded. load (default): the page and its images loaded. domcontentloaded: the HTML is parsed, faster. networkidle: no network traffic for 0.5 s, best for pages that load content late.

name: capture_website_screenshots
title: Capture website screenshots
